violations.why: After irq_jasper enables interrupt 2, irq_nimbus can preempt the task between the two reads of v_hazel and change it from its old value to 11, so the two comparisons see different values.
irq_nimbus can preempt the task between the two reads of v_meadow and write 0x05 to it. Both reads can execute, because v_hazel can change from its old value to 11 between the two conditions.
